decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis upward shift begins in N and U around index 480–485, with E following shortly after (~485–490); the offset persists through at least index 529. A partial relaxation or plateau appears near 530–535, but no definitive return to pre-event levels is observed within the allowed context. The absence of a clear opposing return prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and U rise together from ~480–485, sustained through ~529; E shows delayed but coherent upward shift starting ~485–490. Return not observed before 530; at 530–535, N/U plateau or dip slightly but remain elevated relative to pre-480 baseline, and E does not revert. No clear opposing return within allowed context (445–579).
